name: Metabolic RNA labeling scRNA-seq benchmark
description: Compares metabolic RNA labeling protocols and evaluates their performance for high-throughput single-cell RNA-seq, measuring sensitivity, accuracy of nascent RNA detection, and throughput tradeoffs.
reputation: A specialized benchmark used by bioinformatics and single-cell sequencing researchers to compare metabolic RNA labeling protocols; well regarded within that niche but not widely used outside the field.
notes: Protocol-specific biases, contamination and carryover risk, batch effects and saturation at high read depth, relatively small and domain-specific datasets; non-LLM benchmark focused on wet-lab and bioinformatics metrics.
